title: 第5900章 请你离开第5898章 往事
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
就这样，很快过去了七个月。
苏尘睁开眼睛，他已经将石板上的信息读取得七七八八。
“石板上记载了一件大事，大意是，有一尊无比强大的生灵出现，威胁到了他们的世界，还有无数类似的世界。”
“因此，他们世界的强者便与其他世界的强者联手，共同对抗这尊生灵。”
“至于这尊生灵叫什么名字……”
“这个无法翻译出来，因为名字本身不具备实际意义。”
苏尘轻呼一口气，在脑海中整理着思绪。
石板上所说的强大生灵，该不会就是烬吧？
一切的描述，都和烬十分契合。
但是，年代对不上。
烬不是在大世界诞生之初就存在的，而是大世界发展到某一阶段后，由某个位面的武者突发奇想创造出来的怪物。
从那之后，这怪物渐渐脱离掌控，吞噬了那个位面所有的武者与生灵，甚至连位面本身也一并吞噬，取而代之，从此拉开了位面战争的序幕。
那个时候，霍麒等人应该早就修成合道境七重了。
如果在那之后，有两个位面重叠，一同失落在混沌之中，他们绝不可能一无所知。
所以，从时间线来看，这两个重叠位面的失落时间，早于霍麒等人成名之前。那么这石板记载之中的强大生灵，应该也是比烬早得多才对。
但如果是这样，这么恐怖的生灵又去了哪里，总不会凭空消失吧？
还有那些陨落的合道境七重，本该不死不灭才对。
两个位面重叠，至少需要数百个合道境七重联手才能做到，更是匪夷所思。
苏尘再次轻吐一口气，看来这些谜团还远远没到揭开的时候。
他继续往下深入，虽然早已经有猜测，但当他发现第三个重叠位面出现的蛛丝马迹时，还是觉得有些难以相信。

光是重叠两个位面，就需要数百个七重联手，如果是三个……又需要什么级别的巨大能量？
至少现在所有的合道境七重加在一起，都无法做到，估计烬也不行，否则它既然能重叠位面，又怎么会迟迟拿不下万象位面？
他加快身形，不断向下潜去，合道境之力涌动，任何障碍在他面前都不堪一击，如同纸糊的一般。
就这样穿梭了十几天光景，咻的一声，苏尘破开最后一层地层，身形出现在一片全新的天地之中。
高山拔地而起，高达数万丈，地坑则深达十几万丈，这里之前分明是一片汪洋大海。
但如今海水早已蒸发，只留下一个巨大的天坑。
果然，这里还有第三个位面。
苏尘仔细感应，这里从前应该也是一个高阶位面，可如今已是死寂，只能从六种本质力量的强弱来分辨。
当然，苏尘现在只能感应到其中一种。
他稍稍辨别方向，再次展动身形，飞速前行。
又过了几天，前方出现连绵群山。
苏尘身形落下，打算先简单了解一下这里的情况。
找了几个路人打探之后，苏尘渐渐拼凑出了这个位面的现状。
“这里发现了一处巨型矿藏，经过这些年的开采，剩余的矿藏已经不多，可最精华的部分应该还在，只是谁也没法着手开采，各方势力都在盯着，准备大战一场。”
“在这些势力之中，有不少合道境四重，就连五重也有几个。”
苏尘分析着自己得到的信息，四重的对手他还能应付，但如果是五重，即使他动用九流组合符也难以抗衡。
除非他突破到合道境三重。
content_en:
In this way, seven months passed quickly.
Su Chen opened his eyes, and he had already read the information on the stone tablet to the letter.
"There is a major event recorded on the stone tablet. The general idea is that an extremely powerful creature appeared and threatened their world, as well as countless similar worlds."
"Therefore, the strong men in their world joined forces with the strong men in other worlds to fight against this creature."
"As for the name of this creature..."
"This cannot be translated because the name itself has no actual meaning."
Su Chen took a breath and sorted out his thoughts in his mind.
Could it be that the powerful creature mentioned on the stone slab is Jhin?
All the descriptions fit perfectly with Jhin.
However, the years don't match up.
Jhin did not exist when the big world was born, but was a monster created by the whims of warriors from a certain plane after the big world developed to a certain stage.
From then on, the monster gradually escaped from its control and swallowed up all the warriors and creatures in that plane. It even swallowed up the plane itself and replaced it, thus kicking off the plane war.
By that time, Huo Qi and others should have already reached the seventh level of Hedao Realm.
If after that, two planes overlap and are lost in chaos together, they will never know anything about it.
Therefore, judging from the timeline, these two overlapping planes were lost long before Huo Qi and others became famous. Then the powerful creatures recorded on this stone tablet should be much earlier than Jhin.
But if that's the case, where did such a terrifying creature go? It couldn't disappear out of thin air, right?
There are also those fallen seventh-level Hedao realms who should have been immortal.
The two planes overlap, and it requires at least hundreds of seventh-level Hedao realms to join forces to achieve it, which is even more unbelievable.
Su Chen let out a breath again. It seemed that these mysteries were far from being solved yet.
He continued to delve deeper. Although he had already made a guess, when he found clues about the appearance of the third overlapping plane, he still found it a bit hard to believe.
Just overlapping two planes would require the cooperation of hundreds of seventh-layers. If there were three... what level of huge energy would be needed?
At least all the seventh-level Hedao realms put together cannot do it now, and probably Jhin can't do it either. Otherwise, since it can overlap planes, why has it been unable to take over the plane of all things?
He speeded up his body and continued to dive downwards. The power of the Hedao Realm surged, and any obstacle in front of him was as vulnerable as paper.
After traveling for more than ten days like this, with a whoosh, Su Chen broke through the last layer of the ground and appeared in a brand new world.
Mountains rise from the ground, tens of thousands of feet high, and the pits are hundreds of thousands of feet deep. It was clearly a vast ocean before.
But now the seawater has evaporated, leaving only a huge sinkhole.
Sure enough, there is a third dimension here.
Su Chen carefully sensed that this place should have been a high-level plane before, but now it is dead and silent, and it can only be distinguished by the strength of the six essential powers.
Of course, Su Chen can only sense one of them now.
He discerned the direction slightly, stretched out his body again, and moved forward quickly.
A few days later, mountains appeared in front of us.
Su Chen fell down and planned to briefly understand the situation here.
After asking a few passers-by to inquire, Su Chen gradually pieced together the current situation of this plane.
"A huge mineral deposit has been discovered here. After all these years of mining, there is not much left, but the best part should still be there, but no one can start mining it. All forces are watching and preparing for a war."
"Among these forces, there are quite a few at the fourth level of Hedao realm, and there are even a few at the fifth level."
Su Chen analyzed the information he had obtained. He could still deal with opponents at the fourth level, but if they were at the fifth level, it would be difficult for him to compete even if he used the ninth-level combination talisman.
Unless he breaks throughThe third level of Hedao realm.
